series.title: DNS 间歇超时：缓存掩盖与上游配置遗漏
series.premise: 上午checkout应用部分新连接解析payments.internal超时。现有连接仍可用，故障主要出现在A区使用resolver-a的客户端。两个内部解析器承载相同私有解析策略。
series.outcome: 同路径对照测试发现resolver-a的部分缓存未命中查询落到已退役转发端点。将受影响客户端分批切换至经私有名称、容量和跨区验证的resolver-b，保留配置回退。恢复后核实遗漏的上游池配置，并安排修复、重新接入验收与发布流程调查。

accentTarget.basis: spoken audio duration excluding silence and narration

phraseDefinitions.zh: 按客户端环境返回不同答案的DNS机制

recycling.note: 未来回访为编稿安排，不算实际复现。每段五个旧表达复现自既有库及此前草稿。

dialogues.title: 解析超时：连接故障还是DNS故障
dialogues.premise: checkout新连接出现超时，应用日志报告私有支付名称解析失败。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听出错误发生在建立连接前，不把所有超时归为支付服务宕机。

lines.en: DNS is timing out for payments dot internal. The error rate spiked on new checkout connections.
lines.zh: payments.internal的DNS解析正在超时，结账服务新建连接的错误率陡涨。

lines.en: Before the connection opens? Or after the request reaches payments?
lines.zh: 是在连接建立前，还是请求到达支付服务后？

lines.en: Before connection setup. Existing connections still work. That's why some requests look normal.
lines.zh: 建立连接之前。已有连接仍可用，所以有些请求看起来正常。

lines.en: Okay, I'll take point on this. Just to confirm, don't restart the app yet, right?
lines.zh: 好，我来协调。我确认一下，先不重启应用，对吧？

lines.en: Agreed. A restart could remove working connections and make the impact worse.
lines.zh: 同意。重启可能让正常连接消失，反而扩大影响。

lines.en: Let me tail the log. I'll match lookup errors to the affected hosts.
lines.zh: 我盯一下日志，把查询错误和受影响主机对应起来。

lines.en: Use the application hostname and query type. A random public lookup won't test this path.
lines.zh: 用应用实际查询的名称和记录类型。随便查个公共名称测不到这条路径。

lines.en: What's the ETA for a first comparison? A rough estimate is fine.
lines.zh: 首次对比预计多久？给个大概时间就行。

lines.en: I'll check the same lookup from both zones. We need to locate the boundary.
lines.zh: 我会从两个区域检查同一查询，需要圈定故障边界。

lines.en: About two minutes. I'll keep retries low so the tests don't add load.
lines.zh: 大约两分钟。我会控制测试重试次数，避免增加负载。

dialogues.title: 间歇失败：不是每次成功都代表健康
dialogues.premise: 已知超时发生在DNS阶段，已有连接正常；开始按区域和客户端统计。
dialogues.listeningTask: 辨别失败集中位置和不能从一次成功查询得出的结论。

lines.en: We're seeing intermittent failures in zone A. Zone B's samples are clean so far.
lines.zh: A区出现间歇性失败，B区目前抽样正常。

lines.en: Are all A hosts using the same resolver? Check the effective client settings.
lines.zh: A区主机都使用同一解析器吗？检查客户端实际生效的设置。

lines.en: Affected clients point to resolver A. That's our blast radius so far, not the whole region.
lines.zh: 受影响客户端指向解析器A。目前影响范围是这些客户端，不是整个区域。

lines.en: Just to confirm, one successful lookup doesn't clear A, right? We need repeated samples.
lines.zh: 我确认一下，查成功一次不能证明A正常，对吧？需要多次抽样。

lines.en: Right. A cached result could succeed while fresh requests still fail.
lines.zh: 对。缓存结果可能成功，但新的查询仍会失败。

lines.en: I'm on it. I'll record failures and timings, not just the final answer.
lines.zh: 我来记录失败次数和耗时，不只记录最终答案。

lines.en: I'll keep an eye on B too. A few clean samples aren't a complete health check.
lines.zh: 我也会关注B。少量成功样本不是完整健康检查。

lines.en: Payments itself responds over established connections. We can rule that out as a total outage.
lines.zh: 支付服务通过已有连接可以响应，可以排除整个支付服务完全宕机。

lines.en: Good distinction. That doesn't rule out every payment issue, just a complete outage.
lines.zh: 这个区分很重要。不是排除所有支付问题，只是排除完全宕机。

lines.en: Okay. Keep the scope precise. Let's compare A and B from the same client next.
lines.zh: 好，准确描述范围。接下来从同一客户端对比A和B。

dialogues.title: 同一客户端：别让测试条件变了
dialogues.premise: 失败集中于使用解析器A的客户端，但缓存可能让成功样本误导判断。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听懂同客户端、同名称、同记录类型对比的重要性。

lines.en: Same client, same name, same query type. Recursive resolver A times out; B answers quickly.
lines.zh: 同一客户端、同一名称、同一记录类型。递归解析器A超时，B很快回答。

lines.en: I checked the responses too. B returns the expected private address, not a public endpoint.
lines.zh: 我也核对了响应。B返回预期私有地址，不是公共端点。

lines.en: Is that a direct DNS probe? It may bypass the application's local cache.
lines.zh: 这是直接DNS探测吗？那可能绕过应用本地缓存。

lines.en: Yes. We'll test the app path separately. We shouldn't treat those as identical tests.
lines.zh: 是的，应用路径要单独测，不能把两种测试当作完全一样。

lines.en: Just to confirm, B is reachable from the affected client, right? That's a useful control.
lines.zh: 我确认一下，受影响客户端能访问B，对吧？这是个有用的对照。

lines.en: Let me play that back. The client can reach a working resolver, but A's path still fails.
lines.zh: 我复述一下：客户端能访问一个正常解析器，但走A的路径仍失败。

lines.en: We can rule that out as a blanket client-network failure. A still needs investigation.
lines.zh: 可以排除客户端网络整体不可用，但A仍需要排查。

lines.en: Compare A's response codes and upstream timings next. Don't stop at a yes-or-no result.
lines.zh: 接下来对比A的响应码和上游耗时，不要只看成功或失败。

lines.en: What's the ETA for those metrics? We need a safe mitigation soon.
lines.zh: 拿到那些指标预计多久？我们需要尽快有安全缓解方案。

lines.en: I'm on it for the app-side test. About three minutes if the test host is ready.
lines.zh: 应用侧测试我来做。如果测试主机就绪，大约三分钟。

dialogues.title: 缓存命中：快回答可能掩盖坏路径
dialogues.premise: 同客户端对照显示B正常，A间歇超时；检查A成功回答是否来自缓存。
dialogues.listeningTask: 区分缓存答案、需要上游回答的查询，以及为什么不全站清缓存。

lines.en: A cache hit comes back fast on A. Some uncached lookups take several seconds, then fail.
lines.zh: A的缓存命中会很快返回。有些未缓存查询等几秒后失败。

lines.en: Are you using approved test records? Random names might only test negative caching.
lines.zh: 用的是批准的测试记录吗？随机名称可能只测到不存在记录的负缓存。

lines.en: Yes, existing test records with short lifetimes. Small sample, no query flood.
lines.zh: 是的，用已有的短有效期测试记录，小量抽样，不制造查询洪峰。

lines.en: Just to confirm, no fleet-wide cache flush, right? That could increase upstream load.
lines.zh: 我确认一下，不对全体清缓存，对吧？那可能增加上游负载。

lines.en: Agreed. I'll keep an eye on cache statistics and upstream timeout counts together.
lines.zh: 同意。我会一起关注缓存统计和上游超时次数。

lines.en: The app's cached answers still work. We can't rule that out as the reason some requests succeed.
lines.zh: 应用缓存答案仍可用，不能排除部分请求成功是因为缓存。

lines.en: Exactly. The next question is which upstream path the failed lookups used.
lines.zh: 正是这样。下一步要查失败查询走了哪条上游路径。

lines.en: A full cache reset? Let's park that. What's the ETA for the upstream comparison?
lines.zh: 完整重置缓存先放一边。上游对比预计多久？

lines.en: Two minutes. I'll keep successful and failed samples separate so we don't average away the issue.
lines.zh: 两分钟。我会分开成功和失败样本，避免平均值掩盖问题。

lines.en: Okay. I'll save the current configuration before anyone changes the forwarding targets.
lines.zh: 好。任何人修改转发目标前，我先保存当前配置。

dialogues.title: 一条上游无响应：先定位，再解释
dialogues.premise: A的缓存命中正常，部分未缓存查询失败，准备核对转发目标和请求轨迹。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听清已定位的坏路径与尚待核实的端点退役信息。

lines.en: Let me tail the log. The failed queries point to one upstream forwarder with no reply.
lines.zh: 我盯一下日志。失败查询指向一个上游转发端点，它没有响应。

lines.en: Does A have more than one target? That could explain the intermittent failures.
lines.zh: A有不止一个目标吗？那可能解释间歇失败。

lines.en: Two targets. One replies, one doesn't. B's configured targets are different.
lines.zh: 两个目标，一个响应，一个不响应。B配置的目标不同。

lines.en: Just to confirm, we know the failing endpoint, right? We don't know why it's there yet.
lines.zh: 我确认一下，已经知道失败端点，对吧？还不知道它为什么仍在配置里。

lines.en: Check the inventory and recent changes. Don't remove an endpoint based only on one timeout.
lines.zh: 核对资产清单和近期变更，不能只因一次超时就删端点。

lines.en: Our working hypothesis is a stale forwarding target. The retirement record needs confirmation.
lines.zh: 当前假设是转发目标过期，但还需要确认退役记录。

lines.en: I'll check the approved configuration. We also need to know B preserves the private view.
lines.zh: 我会查批准配置，也要确认B保留同样的私有解析视图。

lines.en: What's the ETA? Can we prepare B without changing any clients yet?
lines.zh: 预计多久？能不能先准备B，但暂时不改客户端？

lines.en: Yes. Check capacity, reachability, and the required private names before proposing a switch.
lines.zh: 可以。提出切换前，检查容量、可达性和必需的私有名称。

lines.en: I'm on it. About three minutes for the checklist. No public resolver shortcut.
lines.zh: 我来做，完成清单大约三分钟。不用公共解析器走捷径。

dialogues.title: 决定切换：私有解析和容量都要过关
dialogues.premise: 发现A存在无响应转发目标，正在核实退役记录；B通过准备检查，可考虑小范围切换。
dialogues.listeningTask: 抓住切换范围、回退条件和客户端是否真正采用新设置。

lines.en: Can we switch resolvers for one affected host first? I want a reversible step.
lines.zh: 可以先让一台受影响主机切换解析器吗？我要可回退的步骤。

lines.en: B has capacity and the same private zones. But verify all critical service names, not just payments.
lines.zh: B有容量，也有相同私有区域，但必须验证所有关键服务名称，不只支付。

lines.en: The checklist passed. This is a temporary workaround to buy us time for A's repair.
lines.zh: 清单检查通过。这是临时缓解，为修复A争取时间。

lines.en: Just to confirm, one host first, right? Save its current settings before the change.
lines.zh: 我确认一下，先一台主机，对吧？变更前保存它当前设置。

lines.en: What's the rollback trigger? Wrong answers, higher error rate, or unexpected resolver load?
lines.zh: 回退触发条件是什么？错误答案、错误率增加，或解析器负载异常？

lines.en: All three mean stop and assess. Restore the saved settings if the canary fails validation.
lines.zh: 这三种都先停止并评估。灰度验证失败，就恢复保存的设置。

lines.en: Check which layer owns DNS settings. Hand-editing a generated file could be overwritten.
lines.zh: 检查哪一层管理DNS设置。手改生成文件可能马上被覆盖。

lines.en: I'm on it. The approved network manager owns it. I'll use its change procedure.
lines.zh: 我来确认。由批准的网络管理器管理，我会按它的变更流程操作。

lines.en: And confirm the app actually uses B. A direct probe alone won't prove that.
lines.zh: 还要确认应用实际使用B，单独直接探测不能证明这一点。

lines.en: Agreed. We'll observe fresh connections. No full app restart just to force a lookup.
lines.zh: 同意，观察新建连接，不为了强制查询而重启整个应用。

dialogues.title: 配置已改：应用真的走新路径了吗
dialogues.premise: 批准一台受影响客户端切换B，保存旧设置并明确验证与回退条件。
dialogues.listeningTask: 区分配置写入成功、解析流量切换成功和业务恢复。

lines.en: Resolver configuration is updated on the canary. Effective settings show B, and the saved copy is intact.
lines.zh: 灰度主机解析器配置已更新，生效设置显示B，旧配置副本也保留完整。

lines.en: I can see new lookups from that client on B. Expected private answers, no new timeouts.
lines.zh: B上能看到该客户端的新查询，返回预期私有答案，没有新增超时。

lines.en: Fresh application connections succeed too. I'll keep an eye on the error rate.
lines.zh: 应用新连接也成功了，我会留意错误率。

lines.en: Just to confirm, enough uncached samples, right? Not just one cached answer?
lines.zh: 我确认一下，未缓存样本也足够，对吧？不是只有一个缓存答案？

lines.en: Yes. And B's load is healthy. Expand in small batches while the checks stay clean.
lines.zh: 是的，B负载正常。检查持续通过时，小批次扩大。

lines.en: I'm on it. What's the ETA before the next batch? I'll record each client's settings.
lines.zh: 我来做，预计什么时候能开始下一批？每台客户端设置都会记录。

lines.en: After five minutes of clean samples. Let's keep it under observation between batches.
lines.zh: 连续五分钟样本正常后，批次之间保持观察。

lines.en: Okay. No blanket cache flush. Each batch needs the same app and resolver checks.
lines.zh: 好，不统一清缓存。每批都要做相同应用和解析器检查。

lines.en: If another host behaves differently, stop there. Its local resolver path may not match.
lines.zh: 如果另一台表现不同，就先停下，它的本地解析路径可能不同。

lines.en: Agreed. Maybe some clients retain old answers briefly. We'll check the actual path, not guess.
lines.zh: 同意。有些客户端可能短暂保留旧答案，我们检查实际路径，不靠猜。

dialogues.title: 跨区检查：回答正确不代表视图一致
dialogues.premise: 受影响客户端分批切换B后错误下降，需验证两区私有解析和业务路径。
dialogues.listeningTask: 理解区域相关答案可能不同，验收要求不是所有地址完全一样。

lines.en: We use split-horizon DNS. The correct answer depends on the client's view and location.
lines.zh: 我们采用分视图DNS，正确答案取决于客户端视图和位置。

lines.en: Both zones return their expected private addresses. I checked against the approved service map.
lines.zh: 两区都返回各自预期私有地址，我和批准的服务映射核对过。

lines.en: Good. Matching addresses everywhere isn't the goal. Correct routing for each client is.
lines.zh: 好。目标不是所有地方地址完全一致，而是各客户端路由正确。

lines.en: Just to confirm, no private names leaked to a public resolver, right?
lines.zh: 我确认一下，没有把私有名称发给公共解析器，对吧？

lines.en: Right. Only approved internal paths. Fresh checkout connections are healthy from both zones.
lines.zh: 对，只走批准的内部路径。两区结账的新连接都正常。

lines.en: We can rule that out as a view mismatch in the tested paths. Keep the coverage recorded.
lines.zh: 在已测路径中可以排除视图不匹配，测试覆盖范围仍要记录。

lines.en: Just to recap, B is serving the switched clients. A is still isolated from those clients.
lines.zh: 小结一下，B正为已切换客户端服务，A仍与这些客户端隔离。

lines.en: I'll keep an eye on B's latency. The extra traffic needs ongoing monitoring.
lines.zh: 我会盯着B的延迟，新增流量需要持续监控。

lines.en: Okay. Can we report we're back to baseline? Include the metrics, not just the probe results.
lines.zh: 好。能报告回到基线了吗？要有指标，不只看探测结果。

lines.en: Yes, errors and latency are normal now. We can report service recovery, with A's repair still pending.
lines.zh: 可以，现在错误和延迟正常。可以报告服务恢复，但A的修复仍待完成。

dialogues.title: 告诉业务方：恢复了，原解析器还没修好
dialogues.premise: 两区验证通过，服务指标恢复；A的原始配置问题和重新接入仍未完成。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听清服务恢复、缓解持续有效与根因修复的不同状态。

lines.en: Support needs an update. Can I say checkout is recovered and the mitigation is holding?
lines.zh: 支持团队需要更新。我能说结账已恢复、缓解持续有效吗？

lines.en: Yes, with the monitoring period stated. Don't say both resolvers are repaired.
lines.zh: 可以，但要写清观察时段。不要说两台解析器都修好了。

lines.en: This is still a temporary workaround. A remains out of the affected clients' configuration.
lines.zh: 这仍是临时缓解。受影响客户端配置里仍不使用A。

lines.en: Just to confirm, next update in thirty minutes, right? Earlier if the error rate rises.
lines.zh: 我确认一下，三十分钟后再更新，对吧？错误率上升就提前。

lines.en: Include the escalation path. The next shift needs to know who handles B if it slows down.
lines.zh: 也写上升级联系路径。下个班需要知道B变慢时找谁。

lines.en: I'll add it. What's the ETA for A's repair? Maybe give a range, not a promise.
lines.zh: 我会补上。A修复预计多久？可以给个范围，不要作保证。

lines.en: We need the approved target list first. Then offline validation before any client moves back.
lines.zh: 先要拿到批准的目标清单，客户端切回前还需要离线验证。

lines.en: About an hour for repair and checks, if the change review is clean. No automatic switch-back.
lines.zh: 变更评审顺利的话，修复和检查大约一小时，不自动切回。

lines.en: And don't publish endpoint details in the customer update. Keep that in the internal record.
lines.zh: 客户更新里不要发布端点细节，那些留在内部记录中。

lines.en: Agreed. Let's circle back after the next check. Recovery is confirmed; permanent repair is separate.
lines.zh: 同意。下次检查后再确认。服务恢复已确认，永久修复是另一件事。

dialogues.title: 遗漏的上游配置：修好端点，还要修流程
dialogues.premise: 服务通过B保持恢复，核对退役记录与发布审计后确认A仍包含旧转发端点。
dialogues.listeningTask: 区分技术原因已确认与配置发布流程仍待调查，并抓住验收任务。

lines.en: The forwarder pool on A still includes a retired endpoint. The retirement record confirms it.
lines.zh: A的转发端点池仍包含已退役端点，退役记录已经确认。

lines.en: Failed samples used that endpoint. That links stale config to timeouts.
lines.zh: 失败样本使用了那个端点，这把过期配置和超时联系起来了。

lines.en: Just to recap, B got the update. A didn't. Why it missed A still needs investigation.
lines.zh: 小结一下，B收到更新，A没有。为什么遗漏A，仍要调查。

lines.en: Use managed configuration to restore A. Don't leave a manual fix outside the source of truth.
lines.zh: 通过统一配置管理修复A，不要把手工修复留在权威配置之外。

lines.en: First action item: review the corrected targets and test A offline. I'll own that today.
lines.zh: 第一个行动项：评审正确目标并离线测试A，我今天负责完成。

lines.en: Who's picking this up for fresh-lookup monitoring? Cached health checks missed the bad path, right?
lines.zh: 新查询监控谁来接？缓存健康检查漏掉了坏路径，对吧？

lines.en: I'll add approved uncached probes by Friday. Small volume, with checks for the private views.
lines.zh: 我周五前加上批准的未缓存探测，保持小量，并检查私有视图。

lines.en: Lukas, review the partial rollout tomorrow. We need to know why success was reported too early.
lines.zh: Lukas，明天评审这次不完整发布。我们需要知道为何过早报告成功。

lines.en: I'll do that. A rejoins only after the repair checks and a reviewed client switch plan.
lines.zh: 我来做。A必须通过修复检查，并有评审过的客户端切换计划，才能重新接入。

lines.en: We'll close the loop with evidence. Keep B monitoring active until the transition is verified.
lines.zh: 我们会带着证据反馈并闭环。切换验证完成之前，继续监控B。
